roleplay.adulthood: Around 100 years, though their bodies reach full mastery around 20
roleplay.text:
Elves belong to an ancient lineage, forged in the deep roots of Eden and the eternal murmurs of the first woods. They are the guardians of a forgotten balance, heirs to ancient pacts between magic, nature and the stars. Their grace hides a constant vigilance, for none watches over the world more ardently than those who have seen its ages fall.

The elvish language is a slow song, woven of poetry and harmonics, that few mortal beings can reproduce faithfully.
